# Syndicated Feeds

## Mastodon and Twitter

You should definitely [follow Daring Fireball on Mastodon](https://mastodon.social/@daringfireball) and [Twitter](https://twitter.com/daringfireball), and perhaps [follow John Gruber](https://mastodon.social/@gruber) [too](https://twitter.com/gruber).

## Subscribe to the Main Feed

The main feed for everything on Daring Fireball:

- RSS: [https://daringfireball.net/feeds/main](https://daringfireball.net/feeds/main)
- JSON: [https://daringfireball.net/feeds/json](https://daringfireball.net/feeds/json)

## The Talk Show

Subscribe to Daring Fireball’s podcast, The Talk Show:

[https://daringfireball.net/thetalkshow/rss](https://daringfireball.net/thetalkshow/rss)

## Articles-Only Feed

A feed containing only the longer, feature articles (like the “old” DF feed) is available as a less-frequently-updated alternative:

[https://daringfireball.net/feeds/articles](https://daringfireball.net/feeds/articles)

## Sponsorship

[Information and rates for week-long exclusive sponsorship](https://daringfireball.net/feeds/sponsors/) of the Daring Fireball feed.
